import os, subprocess, sys
print('GIT env:', {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k.startswith('GIT_')})
print('cwd', os.getcwd(), 'exe', sys.executable, 'version', sys.version)
print('workspace entries', sorted(os.listdir('/workspace'))[:40])
print('.git present:', os.path.exists('/workspace/.git'), 'is dir' if os.path.isdir('/workspace/.git') else '')
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')}
for args in (['git', '-C', '/workspace', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel', 'HEAD'], ['git', '-C', '/workspace', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no']):
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    print('without GIT env', args[3:], p.returncode, p.stdout.strip()[:200], p.stderr.strip()[:200])
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print('with GIT env', args[3:], p.returncode, p.stdout.strip()[:200], p.stderr.strip()[:200])
print('pyvenv.cfg two levels up:', os.path.exists(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(sys.executable)), 'pyvenv.cfg')))
import sysconfig; print('purelib', sysconfig.get_paths()['purelib'])
print('numpy dist:', [d for d in os.listdir(sysconfig.get_paths()['purelib']) if d.startswith('numpy')])
